old_value: {"id":"JMAP-53vd","title":"chat-server: public helper to store server-originated Messages","description":"Extensions (MIMI fanout per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §application/mimi-fanout; also federation inbound delivery) must store Messages the server creates: server-reserved bodyType, server-chosen senderId/senderMsgId/sentAt. Today the only path is ChatBackend::create_object::\u003cMessage\u003e directly (backend.rs:504), which skips (1) dedup by senderMsgId within the Chat (mimi draft: 'MUST NOT store a FanoutMessage whose senderMsgId it has already stored in the Chat'), and (2) ReadPosition creation on a Chat's first message (ensure_read_positions, message.rs:574, private). Add one public fn (e.g. store_server_message(backend, caller, account_id, Message) -\u003e Result\u003cStoredOutcome\u003e) that does both and returns Stored(id) or Duplicate(existing id). Byte-identical-body dedup and hub ChatContact policy stay in the extension.
